# Contributing to STProof

Thank you for your interest in contributing to STProof — the on-chain event timestamping & proof protocol.

## How to Contribute
- Fork the repository
- Create your feature branch (git checkout -b feature/your-feature)
- Commit your changes (git commit -m "Add some feature")
- Push to the branch (git push origin feature/your-feature)
- Open a Pull Request

## Development Environment
- Node.js >= 18
- Hardhat / Foundry
- Git
